نستوئي (form X)
# نَسْتَوْئِي (nastawʔī) /nas.taw.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# نَسْتَوْئِيَ (nastawʔiya) /nas.taw.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
